# Acceptance Criteria

Write acceptance criteria for user stories or requirements as Gherkin scenarios (Given, When, Then) or EARS statements, before development starts: restate what the story changes and list the governing business rules as R1, R2, …, cover for each rule the success scenario, boundary values, negative cases, permission cases and dependency failures, write each scenario in business language with concrete example values and an observable Then, and deliver the Feature block plus a coverage table tracing every scenario to a rule. Missing or unclear rules are never invented — they become open questions addressed to whoever can answer them.
